meta.promptText: Dark spots aur dull skin ke liye India mein konsa vitamin C serum kharidun?

response.text:
Bharat mein dark spots aur dull skin ko theek karne ke liye kai acche aur dermatologically tested Vitamin C serums available hain. Aapki skin type aur budget ke hisab se yeh kuch behtareen options hain:

### 1. Best for Beginners & Everyday Use

* **Minimalist 10% Advanced Vitamin C Serum[www.bestreviewsonline.in](https://www.bestreviewsonline.in/vitamin-c#:~:text=Minimalist.%20Minimalist%2010%25%20Advanced%20Vitamin%20C%20Serum,and%20suitable%20for%20both%20men%20and%20women.)**
  *   * **Kyu kharidein:** Yeh **Ethyl Ascorbic Acid** (ek stable Vitamin C derivative) ke sath aata hai, jo Indian skin par jaldi asar karta hai aur oxidize nahi hota.[www.bestreviewsonline.in](https://www.bestreviewsonline.in/vitamin-c#:~:text=10%25%20STABLE%20VITAMIN%20C%20%28ETHYL%20ASCORBIC%20ACID,Tangy%20Orange%20Flavour%20%7C%7C%20Boost%20Immunity%20%7C%7C) Isme Centella Water bhi hai jo skin ko calm rakhta hai.
  * **Best for:[www.lightupbeauty.com](https://www.lightupbeauty.com/blogs/tips/best-vitamin-c-serum-in-india#:~:text=It%20would%20leave%20the%20skin%20rather%20revitalized%2C,skincare%20game%20with%20its%20budget-friendly%2C%20high-performing%20products.)** Sabhi skin types aur beginners ke liye.[www.bestreviewsonline.in](https://www.bestreviewsonline.in/vitamin-c#:~:text=SUITABLE%20FOR%20ALL%20SKIN%20TYPES%20%26%20INDIAN,skin%20in%20humid%2C%20hot%2C%20or%20urban%20environments.)

### 2. Best for Stubborn Pigmentation & Dark Spots

* **The Ordinary Ascorbic Acid 8% + Alpha Arbutin 2%[www.lightupbeauty.com](https://www.lightupbeauty.com/blogs/tips/best-vitamin-c-serum-in-india#:~:text=Sensitive%20skin%20and%20first-time%20Vitamin%20C%20users,Acid%3A%20Pure%20Vitamin%20C%20for%20brightening.%20.)**
  *   * **Kyu kharidein:** Isme pure Vitamin C ke sath **Alpha Arbutin** hota hai, jo purane se purane acne marks aur dark spots ko tezi se fade karta hai.
  * **Best for:[www.inzoraskin.com](https://www.inzoraskin.com/blogs/news/vitamin-c-serum-for-dark-spots#:~:text=*%20Re'equil%2018%25%20Vitamin%20C%20Face%20Serum.,dark%20spots%20for%20people%20new%20to%20actives.)** Jinhe active ingredients use karne ki aadat hai (not recommended for very sensitive skin).

### 3. Best Budget-Friendly Option

* **Plum 15% Vitamin C Face Serum** ya **Garnier Bright Complete Vitamin C Serum[www.inzoraskin.com](https://www.inzoraskin.com/blogs/news/vitamin-c-serum-for-dark-spots#:~:text=Includes%20bamboo%20extract%2C%20Vitamin%20C%2C%20and%20hyaluronic,*%20Garnier%20Bright%20Complete%20Vitamin%20C%20Serum.)**
  *   * **Kyu kharidein:** Plum ka serum lightweight hai aur dullness ko door karke natural glow deta hai. Garnier pocket-friendly hai aur daily use ke liye acha hai.

### 4. Best with Multi-Benefits (Dullness + Acne Marks)

* **Deconstruct 10% Vitamin C + 5% Niacinamide Serum[www.inzoraskin.com](https://www.inzoraskin.com/blogs/news/vitamin-c-serum-for-dark-spots#:~:text=A%20trusted%20vitamin%20C%20serum%20for%20dark,a%20stable%20and%20powerful%20Vitamin%20C%20derivative.)**
  *   * **Kyu kharidein:** Yeh dark spots ke sath-sath skin barrier ko bhi strong banata hai aur agar aapko acne-prone skin ki samasya hai, toh uske liye best hai.

---

### Kuch Zaroori Tips:

* **Patch Test:[sacredkosmetics.com](https://sacredkosmetics.com/blogs/sacred-journal/vitamin-c-serum-for-indian-skin#:~:text=*%20Zero%20cases%20of%20purging%20or%20irritation,extends%20shelf%20life%2C%20especially%20in%20coastal%20cities.)** Naya serum use karne se pehle 24 ghante patch test zaroor karein.
* **Sunscreen:[www.bestreviewsonline.in](https://www.bestreviewsonline.in/vitamin-c#:~:text=LIGHTWEIGHT%2C%20FAST-ABSORBING%20%26%20NON-STICKY%20Water-light%20texture%20absorbs,refined%2C%20and%20visibly%20more%20even%20over%20time.)** Subah Vitamin C lagane ke baad **Sunscreen** lagana bilkul na bhoolein, warna dhoop ki wajah se spots aur zyada dark ho sakte hain.
* **Storage:[sacredkosmetics.com](https://sacredkosmetics.com/blogs/sacred-journal/vitamin-c-serum-for-indian-skin#:~:text=Indian%20facial%20skin%20differs%20from%20body%20skin,turnover%20takes%2028%E2%80%9345%20days%20in%20Indian%20skin.)** Vitamin C ko aisi jagah rakhein jahan seedhi dhoop na padti ho taaki woh kharab (oxidize) na ho.
